info.title: About Flowsint
info.p1: <0>Flowsint</0> is an <1>investigation and intelligence platform</1> built to support complex research workflows involving <2>people, organizations, infrastructure, and online activity</2>.
info.p2: Whether you're conducting <0>cyber investigations</0>, mapping out <1>fraud networks</1>, or gathering intelligence for <2>threat assessments</2>, Flowsint helps you collect, visualize, and understand fragmented data points in a structured and interactive way.
info.does1: <0>Connects scattered data</0> — emails, domains, social accounts, IPs, phone numbers, addresses, and more — into a single <1>investigative graph</1>.
info.does2: Offers <0>visual enrichers</0> to pivot from one entity to related ones: find <1>connected individuals</1>, discover <2>infrastructure</2>, uncover <3>aliases</3>.
info.does3: <0>Tracks and saves investigation states</0> over time, letting you explore multiple hypotheses or revisit older threads without losing context.
info.does4: Supports <0>live data enrichment</0> from custom or built-in enrichers, giving you <1>actionable insights</1> as you explore.
info.why1: Built for <0>speed and clarity</0> — fast graph rendering, clean UI, responsive enrichers.
info.why2: <0>Flexible graph model</0> that mirrors how investigators think — not just tables and tags, but <1>relationships</1>.
info.why3: Ideal for <0>solo analysts and teams</0> that need to move fast, explore freely, and make sense of <1>partial or messy data</1>.
info.case1: Mapping <0>digital infrastructure</0> of individuals or organizations
info.case4: Visualizing the reach of <0>leaked or exposed data</0>
info.case5: Tracking <0>threat actor behavior</0> across social and technical surfaces
info.p3: Flowsint is designed for <0>professionals</0> who need <1>full control</1> over their investigation logic, from how data is structured to how relationships are interpreted. It's not just a tool — it's a <2>flexible workspace</2> for building intelligence.
